findings.summary: __getstate__ now returns a dict and __setstate__ assumes a dict, so pickles from the previous attrs version (tuple state) fail to load, either leaving all slots unset or raising TypeError.
No test covers loading a legacy tuple-state pickle, so the compatibility break is not caught.
Both new tests are parametrized with only [A], so the parametrization does nothing.
The new module-level class A can clash with other names in the test module.
